actual_scope: Answer PR4958 Open next question 1 by proving scalar minimal-polynomial degree at least 410 for the actual doubled centre Gram at every positive tensor size.
scope_change_reason: The live handoff asks for the exact scalar-polynomial degree. This is a new finite certificate and written all-size implication, not a proof-assistant binding or an audit of the predecessor 409 certificate.
bottleneck_link: Scoped side result: excludes degree-409 scalar annihilators and degree-408 scalar-polynomial inverses. No general circuit cost or selected supplier improvement follows.
stop_rule: Stop at the first verified strict improvement over degree 409, or after a bounded unsuccessful search. The first strict improvement is 410; no larger degree was searched.
evidence: verify.py --emit-result regenerates 819 direct-sum moments, both component lists, a 410-by-410 determinant equal to 58805 modulo 65537 and file hashes. PROOF.md supplies characteristic-zero and all-positive-size implications.
